question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

An open space usually rectangular and enclosed in a building
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Quadrangle"** refers to an open space, usually rectangular, enclosed by buildings, often found in educational institutions. (चतुर्भुजाकार प्रांगण)

 
 
• **Example: **The students gathered in the** quadrangle **for the morning assembly.
 
 
 
• **"Quadrangle"** is an architectural term that describes a four-sided enclosure, typically surrounded by buildings. (चतुर्भुजाकार प्रांगण)
 
 
• **Example: **The university's main **quadrangle** is surrounded by the library, the science building, and the administration office.
 
 

Therefore, the correct one word substitution for the given phrase is **'Quadrangle.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Quadruped** (चौपाया): An animal that has four feet.

 
 
• **Example:** The horse is a **quadruped **that has been used for transportation for centuries.
 
 
 
• **Quinton** (क्विंटन): This is a name and does not fit the context of the question.
 
 
• **Example:** **Quinton** is a popular name in many English-speaking countries.
 
 
 
• **Quintessential** (मूलभूत): Representing the most perfect or typical example of a quality or class.
